svg.title: CPU parallel efficiency by decomposition
svg.desc: Line and marker chart of CPU parallel efficiency, solver speedup over the serial build divided by MPI ranks times OpenMP threads, in percent, against CPU workers on a base-two logarithmic axis, one panel per suite, for the OpenMP thread sweep, the MPI rank sweep, and labelled hybrid placements, with the ideal 100 percent line. Computational diagnostic of measured execution; no confidence intervals.
